top_signals.title: Malaysia’s Sarawak Heads to Polls as Pressure Mounts on Anwar
top_signals.summary: Sarawak will dissolve its state assembly, setting up Malaysia’s fourth regional election this year as Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s ruling coalition faces mounting pressure after a string of electoral setbacks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Volvo Cars shares plunge 31% amid China, U.S. slump and fresh job cuts
top_signals.summary: The Swedish automaker cited a deteriorating environment led by "tougher" market conditions in China and the U.S., which "negatively affected free cash flow."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
